'''Indupar''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]]. It was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]]. It was ruled by the [[Induparan Monarchy]] and [[House Indupar]], including King [[Dahon Indupar]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Indupar was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Governor of the Induparan Crown Worlds was [[Mirash Peet]]. Imperial Commodore [[Soleric]] commanded the [[16th Escort Force]], escorting merchant convoys through the Induparan to protect them from the ''[[Free Lance]]''.<ref name="P&P" />
